technical.summary: MCK shows long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA, price above 200-SMA) but lacks short-term confirmation; oversold oscillators without reversal signals and weak ADX suggest a potential bounce setup rather than a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 49 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale vs 2 purchases, all small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (383.5) with flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and earnings in 49 days creates highly adverse macro conditions for MCK trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (50/200 EMA bullish, price above 200-SMA) combined with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) and oversold oscillators creates a contrarian bounce setup near support (298.68).
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak short-term technicals (price below all short-term EMAs, no momentum confirmation, weak ADX=19.69), FOMC event today, VIX crisis regime (383.5), and earnings risk in 49 days make this a high-risk entry with poor macro tailwinds.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (11/100) and long-term bullish structure (50/200 EMA) present contrarian appeal, weak short-term technicals (price below all short-term EMAs, no momentum confirmation, ADX 19.69) lack the confirmation needed for a high-conviction swing entry in a VIX crisis regime.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event today combined with VIX crisis (383.5) and earnings in 49 days creates a perfect storm of macro and event risk; any bounce could reverse violently on policy announcement or earnings miss.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; technical, fundamental, and risk agents all score low (2–4); only sentiment offers contrarian support, but insufficient to override macro headwinds and portfolio concentration.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MCK with 19 open Health Care positions (20% of portfolio); adding to concentration in high-volatility sector during crisis VIX regime violates risk management discipline.
